name: RightDomain
description: The domains rights are grouped into. One domain is one uint64 bitset at runtime, which is why a right is only identified by domain and name together. The rights of each domain are in ../rights.json; this file is the closed set of domain names that db/role_rights.json stores.
notes: The stored value is the lowercase snake_case form, never the enum name. It is what appears in role_rights.domain and it is stable forever.

Adding a domain is free and needs no migration. Moving an existing right from one domain to another is not: the bit only means anything together with the domain, so that is a renumbering — see ../rights.json.
